APPSC Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: There are 37 total vacancies across 4 posts. The number of vacancies is based on the Proforma of Requisition submitted by the concerned departments and may change. Out of the 7 Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer posts, 1 is reserved for PwBD candidates under the Deaf & Hard of Hearing/Partially Deaf category. This vacancy count also excludes 2 Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer posts covered under a pending writ petition, WP(C) No. 549/2025.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing in the final semester examination of the qualifying course for Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer or Sub-Treasury Officer may also apply, but must submit proof of having passed the qualifying exam in original on or before the date of interview fixed by the Commission, failing which they will not be allowed to appear in the interview. For Assistant Director (Prosecution) and Assistant Public Prosecutor, applicants must mandatorily submit their 7-year experience certificate (or the Magistrate's appointment order, as applicable) while filling the online application, failing which their candidature will be rejected. Permanent Residence: Must be a citizen of India and an inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) Indigenous Status: Must be an original inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh and hold an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate Indigenous Tribal Language Proficiency: Must be able to speak an Indigenous Tribal Language of Arunachal Pradesh and possess working knowledge of the local indigenous tribes

rows.educational_qualification_eligibility_co: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce/Business Administration/Economics, OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with Statistics or Mathematics as one of the subjects (studied as a compulsory subject in all semesters/years) from a recognized University

Bachelor's Degree in Commerce/Business Administration, OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with Economics and Statistics as subjects (Statistics or Economics studied as a compulsory subject in all semesters/years) from a recognized University
Bachelor of Law from a recognized University with a minimum of 7 years of active practice as an advocate in criminal courts, OR experience as a Magistrate of the First Class
Bachelor of Law from a recognized University with a minimum of 7 years of experience in criminal law practice

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of receipt of the online application form, i.e., 12 October 2026. The date of birth accepted will be as per the Matriculation Certificate issued by a recognized Board; no other documents relating to age (horoscope, affidavits, etc.) will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to pay a fee of ₹200/- through online mode only. PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee as per Section 19 of the Arunachal Pradesh Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates appear in a Written Examination as per the notified Scheme of Examination. The Concerned Subject for Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer and Sub-Treasury Officer is any one of Commerce, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics (Paper-I and Paper-II). For Assistant Director (Prosecution) and Assistant Public Prosecutor, Paper-I covers Core Criminal Laws and Paper-II covers Constitutional Law and Other Special Legislations. To qualify for the viva-voce, a candidate must score an aggregate of 33% of total marks in the written examination, with at least 20% in each paper/subject. PwBD candidates must score an aggregate of 20%, with at least 10% in each paper/subject. Around 3 times the number of advertised vacancies are called for interview. This Recruitment Test serves only as a Screening Test - marks obtained in it are not counted toward the final merit. Of the qualified candidates, 12 times the number of advertised posts (or as decided by the Commission) are admitted to the Written Examination.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Group A & B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 06/2026 issued by the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission for the Common Recruitment Examination for Group-A & Group-B, Gazetted (Technical) Posts-2026 (Part-II), covering 37 posts in the Finance and Home Departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 37 vacancies: 7 Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer, 7 Sub-Treasury Officer, 5 Assistant Director (Prosecution), and 18 Assistant Public Prosecutor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 12 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only citizens of India who are Permanent Residents of Arunachal Pradesh, hold Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) status, and are proficient in an indigenous tribal language, along with the post-specific educational qualification, are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for these APPSC posts?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Commerce/Economics/Statistics/Mathematics for Finance & Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer and Sub-Treasury Officer; a Bachelor of Law with 7 years of relevant experience for Assistant Director (Prosecution) and Assistant Public Prosecutor.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years as on 12 October 2026, with relaxation of up to 5 years for APST candidates and up to 15 years for APST PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹200/- online; PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) and apply online at appsc.gov.in between 21 September 2026 and 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for APPSC Group A B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A Written Examination (General English & General Studies, plus two Concerned Subject papers) followed by a Viva-Voce, for a total of 500 marks; a screening Recruitment Test may be conducted first if applicant numbers are high.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for these APPSC posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from ₹44,900–1,42,400 (Sub-Treasury Officer) to ₹56,100–1,77,500 plus Special Pay (Assistant Director, Prosecution), depending on the post.
